title: Archaeal histone HTkC hypercompacts DNA
authors: Schwab S; Hu Y; Yamamoto S; Yamaura K; Takemata N; Hartmann MD; Cajili MK; van Erp B; Atomi H; Alva V; Alvarez BH; Dame RT
one_liner_zh: 该文研究古菌组蛋白HTkC与DNA形成超致密核蛋白复合物的结构与功能，属于蛋白质-DNA互作体系，但未涉及AI或物理模拟方法，且非典型TF-DNA体系，故为中档匹配。
abstract:
Summary

Histones are important organizers of chromatin in eukaryotes and archaea. In eukaryotes, the core histones assemble with DNA to form the octameric nucleosome. In archaea, histones form hypernucleosomes that are not restricted to an octameric histone core but can extend to variable lengths. We previously identified face-to-face (FtF) histones as a widely distributed group of archaeal histones that assemble into toroidal tetramer structures, distinct from nucleosomal histones. Here, we characterize the FtF histone HTkC from Thermococcus kodakarensis , which also encodes the canonical histones HTkA and HTkB. We show that HTkC wraps DNA around its toroidal tetramer and forms highly compact nucleoprotein complexes, achieving a level of compaction approximately twice that of hypernucleosomes. Consistent with a major chromatin-organizing role, htkC is among the most highly expressed genes in T. kodakarensis and its deletion leads to impaired growth. Together, these findings establish FtF histones as important organizers of archaeal chromatin alongside classical histones.
abstract_zh:
摘要

组蛋白是真核生物和古菌中染色质的重要组织者。在真核生物中，核心组蛋白与DNA组装形成八聚体核小体。在古菌中，组蛋白形成超核小体，其不限于八聚体组蛋白核心，而是可以延伸至可变长度。我们此前鉴定出面对面 (face-to-face, FtF) 组蛋白作为古菌组蛋白中广泛分布的一类，它们组装成环形四聚体结构，与核小体组蛋白不同。在此，我们表征了来自Thermococcus kodakarensis的FtF组蛋白HTkC，该生物还编码经典组蛋白HTkA和HTkB。我们表明，HTkC将其环形四聚体周围的DNA包裹，并形成高度紧凑的核蛋白复合物，达到的紧凑程度约为超核小体的两倍。与主要的染色质组织角色一致，htkC是T. kodakarensis中表达最高的基因之一，其缺失导致生长受损。综合这些发现，确立了FtF组蛋白与经典组蛋白一起作为古菌染色质的重要组织者。
